title: Thread the dispatched artifact path through the host contract gate + evolve phase verify (delta-mode residual of the runner-seam fix)
problem: PR #447 made the dispatched path the one source at the RUNNER verify seam (Roots.DispatchedArtifact). The no-override seams — host contract gate (deliverable/verifier.go rootsFor via Reviewer.Review), salvage-rung re-check, and evolve phase verify — still judge the contract path; under EVOLVE_INTENT_DELTA (operator mode, no in-repo caller) they would block a phase that wrote its dispatched intent-delta.md correctly. Latent, review-MEDIUM scoped out of #447.
fix: Thread the dispatched path through core.ReviewInput at the runner->gate handoff and through phase_verify's request derivation, reusing Roots.DispatchedArtifact; or single-source the delta filename into the contract resolver mode-aware.
acceptance: Under EVOLVE_INTENT_DELTA a delta cycle passes the host gate + phase verify judging intent-delta.md; non-delta byte-identical; wiring proof at the gate seam.
